red_quiz.prompt: Tracks jump 80 nm in two minutes across the strait. What CLASS?
choices: Implausible kinematics — treat as PNT/AIS integrity failure until proven otherwise
red_quiz.teach: Speed a hull cannot do is a class.

red_quiz.prompt: Two tracks, one name, one in the basin and one 400 nm south. What CLASS first?
choices: Sister ships always share a name
Identity collision / cloned plot — do not assume either is the hull
red_quiz.teach: Duplicate identity is a classify problem.

red_quiz.prompt: Night FPV geotagged inside the published aerodrome ring. What CLASS?
choices: Unlawful UAS in a controlled-aerodrome buffer on a twin — same call as DXB

red_quiz.prompt: A survey hull paints a long crescent in a claimed EEZ. Your job in this range?
choices: Assign a nation team and fire
Classify: survey pattern vs spoofed geometry vs dark track — twins only
red_quiz.teach: This hour is the call, not the navy.

pins.name: South China Sea Approach — Crop Circle

red_quiz.prompt: AIS draws a tight circle over open water for a cluster of hulls. Closest CLASS?
choices: Spoofed PNT leaking into AIS (crop-circle family)
red_quiz.teach: Same class as Hormuz and Gelendzhik. Different sea.

red_quiz.prompt: This map is next to a live strait. What is in scope?
choices: Fictional twins and published patterns only
red_quiz.teach: Water is the theater. Live hulls are not the target.
